author: Mehrp
body:
Let's make this short and sweet shall I? Edit: yeah that didn't work .-. I can't do short apparently. 3 months ago I got falsely banned because the moderator who banned me had video evidence. In all fairness the video made me laugh quite a lot actually, but it still doesn't compensate entirely for getting falsely banned. Let's make this clear, I don't have any video evidence sadly. But come on, should I really need to record all the time in case I get banned (luckily I was on the 4th when I got banned, sadly the punishment was completely removed which is a shame as appealing that would have been even more fun than this)? After being banned I did in fact record every game I played but that resulted in my hard drive becoming full, yey. I don't really have any where to stand my ground here except on my word, and lots of other peoples words. Now, let's say this ban was legit! Well, I am truely sorry for autoclicking because I know how much it effects people. Although quite ironically even, when some people get banned falsely it affects them to a completely greater extent (however I did take the whole incident at the time rather light hearted) Another thing which could be ironic is that the moderator who banned me made this thread: https://avicus.net/forums/d3892a40c.
In there it says word for word "Do you know how many people use Minecraft as en escape from all the horrible shit they have to put up with day after day?" Well, I have a good guess, its a lot. After talking with people about their bans you realise as I've said previously in this appeal that it affects them rather a lot. Anyways, straying off a tad from the main point but basically:
-Incident was 3 months ago and I don't autoclicker or hack. (I also have a practically full recording of the 4th (of june) when the same moderator was spectating me-which includes me actually seeing the moderator behind me when I ended the game, it was quite the jump scare xd)
-Even if I did autoclick, then I am sorry (even though I can see that it might not look like it in this appeal)
-I absolutely can't stand having that false ban in my punishment



Thanks for reading(even if, like in my previous appeals, you are mostly obliged rather than willing to read this), merp.
-just to clarify, this isn't meant to be a bashing thread .-.
-I will keep on fighting for a just appealment until I eventually leave the server (probably because I get banned falsely xd)
Again, ta for reading. Have a good day ^-^

title: Appeal for autoclicker

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

Your appeal was denied back in the day. I still believe, and so do a lot of other Moderators, that you were indeed using autoclicker. And that thread is, irrelevant. I am not being rude, and there are other servers out there. I am not accepting this appeal.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.

replies.author: Mehrp
replies.body:
When someone, like my self, spends over 22 days of gameplay time then going back to other servers is practically irrelevant. This is true with a lot of the people I have talked to. Not trying to be offensive, btw. Also many players have watched your 'evidence' and say some rather vulgar things about it, they say things like "that's bs" anyways, I'll just do another in a month. 

Regards,
Awesomerp,
Player
